stock.description: Quantong Holdings Limited functions as an investment holding company, primarily specializing in providing foundation contracting services to both public and private sectors throughout Hong Kong. Additionally, the firm offers machinery leasing and comprehensive services for the procurement and installation of new energy vehicle charging infrastructure. Established in 2014, the company was formerly known as Pak Wing Group (Holdings) Limited before officially adopting the name Quantong Holdings Limited in February 2021. Its main office is situated in Wan Chai, Hong Kong.
